t: This is the war memorial of St Mary Magdalene's Church, in Regent's Park. It was made by Nathaniel Hitch, a British sculptor who lived from 1846 to 1938. He trained as an apprentice and studied at the Borough Polytechnic, and he built a career carving altarpieces, church furniture and other decorative features for churches. So this is a church memorial by a craftsman who knew church work well. I don't have more detail on its history, so look at the carving and read the names or words.
